intro.text: A member of the Sons of Honor and of Ialai Sadeas's inner circle in the warcamps.

items.text: Once an unimportant lighteyed scribe, Ulina joined Ialai Sadeas in her bid to seize power in the warcamps after many of their people left for Urithiru, and through her joined the Sons of Honor. Ialai, who had become quite reclusive, often sent Ulina to do tasks she didn't want to do herself.

Ulina helped recruit "Chanasha Hasareh" for the Sons of Honor, drugging her with some fellow conspirators and bringing her to Ialai. After Ialai's death, Adolin's soldiers gagged and arrested Ulina and the remaining Sons of Honor.
